note: The Nova Vulgata reads: «_Dominus Iesus Christus!» in gloriam dei patris_, and not, as in the Vulgate: _Dominus Jesus Christus in gloria est dei patris_, thus identifying the confession of “every tongue” as an acclamation consisting of three words. – Klaus Gamber: In gloria est dei patris. Zu einer Textänderung in der Neo-Vulgata. _Biblische Zeitschrift_ 24 (1980) 262–266.

_vos gaudete et congratulamini mihi_ – rejoice, and join me in rejoicing; freut euch und freut euch mit mir (not: beglückwünscht mich, as the Tusculum-Vulgata has it). See above in the glossary s.v. _congratulari_ (Chapter 19.2).
